SMQL EngineState Machine Query Language

Your data has a lifecycle. Your database should understand it.

Start Learning
Quick Start
Language Reference
🔄

Declarative State Machines

Define machines with states, transitions, guards, and data fields in a single declaration. No boilerplate, no ORM.

➡️

First-Class Transitions

Transitions are not afterthoughts. Guards, mutations, actions, timeouts, and memos are part of the transition definition.

⏱️

Native Time

Built-in TIMEOUT clauses on transitions. Automatic timer management with cancel-on-exit semantics.

🧩

Machine Composition

Parent-child hierarchies with ALL/ANY predicates and CASCADE transitions. Build complex systems from simple machines.

🌐

HTTP/JSON API

Axum-powered server with REST endpoints, WebSocket subscriptions, and Prometheus metrics out of the box.

📊

Built-in Analytics

FUNNEL analysis, PATH analysis, AGGREGATE queries with GROUP BY, and immutable audit trails for every instance.

🦀

Rust SDK + Codegen

Type-safe Rust client with builder pattern queries, WebSocket subscriptions, and code generation from machine definitions.

💾

Schema Evolution

ALTER MACHINE to add states, fields, and transitions to production machines without losing existing data.
